targetAudience: PMs and leads taking a GenAI PoC to production
topic: The PoC was cheap. Production costs far more. Why?
coreInsight: PoC costs hide four multipliers — real volume, longer context, retries and tool calls, and eval runs — so model cost per completed task at full scale before you commit.

script.onScreen: BEFORE YOU SCALE / Model the cost envelope early. / Estimate daily requests at full rollout · Measure real prompt size, not the demo’s · Count model calls per task, including retries · Budget eval runs for every prompt or model change / Report cost per completed task, not cost per call.

caption:
A PoC runs a few people, short prompts and one call per question. Production runs none of those.

What multiplies between the demo and the launch:
→ volume: every user, every day
→ context: retrieved documents and chat history make prompts longer
→ retries and tool calls: one task can mean several model calls
→ eval runs: you re-test on every prompt or model change

Model this before the business case goes in. The unit that matters to finance is cost per completed task, not cost per call.

Save this before you scale a PoC.
